name: agent-doe-engine
description: A design-of-experiments engine for tuning AI agents. Optimize several competing metrics at once (latency, cost, bundle size, coverage): plan a DOE test matrix, measure each run, and select the best trade-off by weighted scalarization, Derringer-Suich desirability, or Pareto frontier. Falls back to a single-variable autoresearch loop. numpy-only, host-agnostic.
